scientific_integrity: One analytically proved endpoint characterization with one supplementary finite exact-rational checker. No formal or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real normed spaces of dimension at least three, fixed ratio exactly 2/3 only; no assertion for ratios below 2/3. Uses published equilateral-triangle characterization and planar convex-hull median theorem. An earlier equivalent endpoint construction cannot be categorically excluded by bibliographic search.
title: The endpoint \(\lambda=2/3\) in a Fermat–Torricelli characterization of Hilbert norms
